    Profile

    Flamel is a young chimera. He's a hybrid of human kind, long-tail rabbits, and white dream herons. Because of that, he's able to produce two sounds at the same time. In the world of magic, that's a highly regarded ability, so he became a court mage. His vulnerability, though, is that he cannot bear the pressure of the expectations from his surroundings.
